# Twenty original soundtracks

Six original sixteen-bar loops, composed for this project. No external songs or samples are used. The WAV files contain layered synthesized instruments and circular reverb tails for continuous playback.

Edit `scripts/music-scores.mjs` and run `node scripts/render-music.mjs` to regenerate the tracks and their content-hashed filenames. Music loads only when enabled, one game at a time.

- Whisker Waltz: 110 BPM, 26.18 seconds.
- Cloud Paws: 122 BPM, 31.48 seconds.
- Moonlit Pond: 78 BPM, 49.23 seconds.
- Lantern Rooftops: 128 BPM, 30 seconds.
- Sugar Paw Parade: 106 BPM, 36.23 seconds.
- Neon Yarn: 116 BPM, 33.1 seconds.
